name: RadioGroup
summary: Selects one option from a named group.

useWhen: Choosing exactly one option from a short, visible list
avoidWhen: Choosing from a long list; use Select
Switching a mode that applies as soon as it is chosen; use ToggleButtonGroup

obligations: Expose the group name and radio relationships.
Expose selected, disabled, and invalid state.

behavior: Controlled and uncontrolled string values are supported.
Size is applied to every option target; indicators may remain visually compact.
Use options or children, not both: passing both throws a TypeError.
RadioField options go in as children and must sit inside the group.
The group supplies the selected value and size to its RadioField children.
Interactive control sizes use the shared sm, md, and lg targets; md is the default.
Named forms submit the selected option value, and form reset restores the default value.

errorMessage shows one message for the whole group. It renders only while the group is invalid, through the invalid prop or failed native, custom, or server validation, and replaces the built-in message; it never makes the group invalid by itself.
The group error is linked to the radiogroup's description relationship, so it needs no id and no per-option copy. An option's own RadioField Error is for a message about that one option.
accessibility: Expose the group name and radio relationships.
Expose selected, disabled, and invalid state.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
